summary.en: Six free-tier vendors magpie has no preset for — LLM7, NaraRoute, xKiro, SambaNova, Cohere and Hugging Face — each its own provider card, with per-account model discovery and paste-a-key sign-in.
summary.zh: 六家含免费额度、而 magpie 内置预设里没有的渠道：LLM7、NaraRoute、xKiro、SambaNova、Cohere、Hugging Face。每家一张卡、各存各的 key，模型目录按账号实时拉取。
